title: Inspect European Bank residual read sites
changes: Record the retained Bank read-site evidence for the three remaining unowned words and keep their address provenance and runtime ownership open.
validation: Protected unit rm1pwc1a restores the archived capture under lease, verifies its hash and the exact EUR ROM, finds one captured 32-bit Bus read for each word, and retires the report unchanged.
limitations: Each captured scope contains a Thumb LDR r0, [r0], but nested HLE/DMA accesses can inherit instruction scope. Other scenes, readers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No replay or performance comparison was performed.
